KNITWEAR & LAYERS

STUDY 170
Black Ribbed Zip Crop & White Jeans
Rights check
Source: 25067.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight light brown
hair blowing slightly across her face stands against a
white backdrop. She wears a fitted black ribbed knit
cropped zip cardigan with a crew neck and a small
embroidered mark. A black belt sits over wide white
denim trousers. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft,
even studio light. Palette of black, white, and warm skin
tones. Clean and sleek, in the style of a minimal
streetwear catalog.
Clean, sleek, minimal
WORKING NOTES
- The ribbed zip crop and white denim are the key
contrast.
- Keep the windblown hair for movement against the white
backdrop.
